positive.description: Use a dedicated new reviewer account and a test Supabase provider. Verify the actual signup, connection and original-client return.
positive.prompt: Set up Dreambase, connect my Supabase project, and bring me back here.
positive.tools_triggered: Host OAuth before tool access; whoami, list_workspaces, list_connectors, list_connections; request_connector_connection and get_connection_request if an existing account needs a source
positive.expected_behavior: Complete browser signup/consent and authorized provider connection through the original OAuth flow. Verify the named reviewer workspace and a usable connection. Do not create alert destinations without a user request.

positive.description: Acme Review has daily_signups with known UTC dates and counts, and a test source with an additional known channel column.
positive.prompt: In Acme Review, compare weekly signups for the last four complete UTC weeks. Use saved data if it covers the question; otherwise build and save a scratch view.
positive.tools_triggered: whoami, list_workspaces, list_datasets, get_dataset as needed, query_dataset; list_connections, get_connection, search_connection, save_dataset only when source fields are missing
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual schema and fixture totals. Author exact source definitions without invoking another planning agent. Verify saved rows and disclose complete-week boundaries. Do not promote without separate retention consent.

positive.description: Acme Review has a durable signup dataset and one saved signup metric with known daily history.
positive.prompt: Explain our signup KPI and show its trend from saved history.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the stored definition and returned historical values, identify date coverage and counting rules, and do not create a duplicate metric.

positive.description: Acme Review is writable by the reviewer with skills read/write and data-domains read/write scopes.
positive.prompt: Save this workspace context: trial users count as active only after their first completed export. Create an Activation data domain with that rule and then update its notes to say UTC days.
positive.tools_triggered: list_skills, create_skill, list_data_domains, create_data_domain, update_data_domain, get_skill, get_data_domain
positive.expected_behavior: Store the supplied context without generation or source execution. Save and verify the requested counting rule and notes, preserve unrelated existing fields, and report observed IDs.

positive.description: Use a manager account with completed monitoring evidence. On capable ChatGPT Work, validate a native event subscription; elsewhere use an approved test email destination.
positive.prompt: Review our latest Supabase findings, then help me receive critical alerts for this review project.
positive.tools_triggered: list_connections, get_engineering_alerts, get_supabase_monitoring, get_observability_alerts; authorized update_observability_alerts and host events/subscribe or add_observability_alert_channel
positive.expected_behavior: Report measured evidence and check time. Confirm requested destination and response behavior, configure only authorized rules and project filters, verify a live subscription/channel, and distinguish configuration from delivery. Never toggle minute collection.
